legend: In a small town, hidden from prying eyes in the mountains, archaeologists stumbled upon a mysterious cave. Inside, they discovered ancient manuscripts written in an unknown language. After long studies and deciphering the text, the scholars concluded that the records belong to a well-known civilization that existed thousands of years ago and contain information about a certain mathematical problem. They believe that solving this problem may be important for their research, and therefore ask you to write a program to solve it.

The problem is formulated as follows: an array b$$$b$$$ is called bumpy if each of its internal elements (that is, not the first or the last) is strictly greater than or strictly less than both of its neighbors.
Initially, a certain array a$$$a$$$ consisting of integers is given. In one operation, you can choose a certain element of the array and increase or decrease it by 1.
You need to determine the minimum number of operations required to make the array a$$$a$$$ bumpy.
input: The first line of input contains one integer n(3≤n≤105)$$$n\, (3 \le n \le 10^5)$$$ — the length of the array a$$$a$$$.
The second line contains n$$$n$$$ integers a1,a2,…,an(−109≤ai≤109)$$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n\, (-10^9\le a_i \le 10^9)$$$ — the values of the elements of the array a$$$a$$$.
output: Output the minimum number of operations required to make the array a$$$a$$$ bumpy.

legend.ai: 在一个远离尘嚣、隐匿于群山之中的小镇里，考古学家偶然发现了一个神秘的洞穴。他们在洞穴中发现了一些用未知语言写成的古代手稿。经过长时间的研究和文字破译，学者们得出结论：这些记录属于一个存在于数千年前的著名文明，并且其中包含了某个数学问题的信息。他们认为，解决这个问题可能对他们的研究十分重要，因此请你编写程序来解决它。
问题表述如下：如果数组 b$$$b$$$ 中的每个内部元素(即既不是第一个元素也不是最后一个元素)都严格大于或严格小于它的两个邻居，则称该数组为凹凸数组。
初始时给定一个由整数构成的数组 a$$$a$$$。在一次操作中，你可以选择数组中的某个元素，并将其增加或减少 1。
你需要确定使数组 a$$$a$$$ 变得凹凸不平所需的最少操作次数。

第二行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个整数 a1,a2,…,an(−109≤ai≤109)$$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n\, (-10^9\le a_i \le 10^9)$$$，表示数组 a$$$a$$$ 中各元素的值。

output.ai: 输出使数组 a$$$a$$$ 变得凹凸不平所需的最少操作次数。
